top_violation_types.title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))
Requirements for Feeding Infants - No Walking or Sleeping with Bottle or Cup (26 TAC §746.2419(7))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: An infant was observed sleeping with a bottle.

top_violation_types.title: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3407(12))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A cleaning bottle was not labeled in a classroom with children present.

top_violation_types.title: Required Admission Information-Child's allergies and Completed Food Allergy Plan (26 TAC §746.605(15))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The standard is evaluated for a standard investigation and is not compliant. The operation does not have a complete food allergy plan for a child with a diagnosis food allergy.

top_violation_types.title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: During the investigation and video, it was found that the caregiver did not demonstrate a high level of judgment or self-control.

top_violation_types.title: Infant Care Area - Space to Walk Between Cribs, Cots or Mats (26 TAC §746.2403(5))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Three infant cribs were placed adjacent to one another, preventing staff from accessing the children that were napping.

top_violation_types.title: No Blocked or Locked Doors as Exits (26 TAC §746.5209(c))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: An exit located on the outdoor play area was blocked as bushes had grown around the exit gate.

top_violation_types.title: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered (26 TAC §746.3701(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The school age building still had a broken electrical outlet in the library center.
